spec.title: AI-Native Lean card B — Typed builders and indexed state

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Use ordinary Lean types and explicit evidence to make the modeled invariant visible.

p.APPLICABILITY: An API can construct an invalid modeled state or omit a required proof.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Inductive/structure definitions, checked constructors and named preservation theorem.

p.SCOPE: Lean elaboration checks the selected source; there is no package-specific builder generator or proof that the modeled invariant matches the world.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: A simple data type plus explicit validation can be clearer than excessive dependent indexing.

p.RISKS: Types can encode the wrong model; revisit an encoding when its proof burden obscures the independent contract. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES. WISH fields identify absent machinery.
